say:1:1720815001:1.source_cn: 两位尊敬的顾客……看上去都有些眼熟呢。

say:2:1720815002:1.source_cn: 请问有什么可以帮您的吗？

say:3:1720815003:1.text: Cash these in and put them on my account.
say:3:1720815003:1.source_cn: 兑换青符，先记到我账上。

say:4:1720815004:1.text: I'm afraid I can't do that.
say:4:1720815004:1.source_cn: 抱歉，暂时无法为您兑换呢。

say:5:1720815005:1.text: Guests who disrupt the balance of the game may be barred from playing or from exchanging tokens.
say:5:1720815005:1.source_cn: 根据会馆规定，影响游戏平衡，以及诸位宾客的游戏体验的顾...

say:8:1720815007:0.text: I didn't. But thank you for confirming.
say:8:1720815007:0.source_cn: 原本我是不知道的，但经您这么一说……现在，我可以确定了。
say:8:1720815007:0.male: I didn't. But thank you for confirming.
say:8:1720815007:0.female: I didn't. But thank you for confirming.

say:10:1720815009:0.text: Hehe... my apologies, Magister Merlin. It's just a joke. The pavilion's illusion magic has a special feature.
say:10:1720815009:0.source_cn: 呵呵……抱歉，梅林阁下，开个玩笑。其实，这是会馆幻术魔...
say:10:1720815009:0.male: Hehe... my apologies, Magister Merlin. It's just a joke. The pavilion's illusion magic has a special feature.
say:10:1720815009:0.female: Hehe... my apologies, Magister Merlin. It's just a joke. The pavilion's illusion magic has a special feature.

say:11:1720815013:1.text: Within the pavilion, the staff can see each other's true forms.
say:11:1720815013:1.source_cn: 在会馆的幻术魔法下，只有员工才能露出真身。
say:11:1720815013:1.male: Within the pavilion, the staff can see each other's true forms.
say:11:1720815013:1.female: Within the pavilion, the staff can see each other's true forms.

say:12:1720815014:1.text: Valen may not work here directly, but he is still considered one of us.
say:12:1720815014:1.source_cn: 而维伦，虽然他并不直接在会馆中工作，但也是我们中的一员。
say:12:1720815014:1.male: Valen may not work here directly, but he is still considered one of us.
say:12:1720815014:1.female: Valen may not work here directly, but he is still considered one of us.

say:13:1720815015:1.text: For ease of communication, we see his true appearance rather than the illusion shown to normal guests.
say:13:1720815015:1.source_cn: 为了保证彼此联络方便，在我们这些员工眼中，维伦并非正常...
say:13:1720815015:1.male: For ease of communication, we see his true appearance rather than the illusion shown to normal guests.
say:13:1720815015:1.female: For ease of communication, we see his true appearance rather than the illusion shown to normal guests.

say:14:1720815016:1.text: And, of course, there's the mark he carries.
say:14:1720815016:1.source_cn: 更何况，维伦身上还有一道特殊的标记……
say:14:1720815016:1.male: And, of course, there's the mark he carries.
say:14:1720815016:1.female: And, of course, there's the mark he carries.

say:15:1720815017:1.text: "Bearers of this mark are prohibited from playing or exchanging tokens." (Giggle) It's quite hard to miss.
say:15:1720815017:1.source_cn: “根据规定，持有此标记者，不允许参与牌局，以及兑换青符...
say:15:1720815017:1.male: "Bearers of this mark are prohibited from playing or exchanging tokens." (Giggle) It's quite hard to miss.
say:15:1720815017:1.female: "Bearers of this mark are prohibited from playing or exchanging tokens." (Giggle) It's quite hard to miss.

say:16:1720815018:1.text: That was years ago! Why are we still bringing it up?
say:16:1720815018:1.source_cn: 咳，那都多少年前的事了，怎么现在还在提这个？

say:17:1720815019:1.text: The Solitaries have grown so much, surely it's time to let go of outdated rules!
say:17:1720815019:1.source_cn: 隐士这些年发展得这么快，也是时候淘汰掉一些落后的规矩了...

say:19:1720815021:1.text: Which is why you're allowed to play, you're just not allowed to cash in those tokens.
say:19:1720815021:1.source_cn: 所以我们没有直接禁止你玩牌，只是拒绝为你兑换青符而已。

choice_prompt:20:1720815021.text: Which is why you're allowed to play, you're just not allowed to cash in those tokens.
choice_prompt:20:1720815021.source_cn: 所以我们没有直接禁止你玩牌，只是拒绝为你兑换青符而已。

say:21:1720815022:1.text: See? Mei, I promised him half!
say:21:1720815022:1.male: See? Mei, I promised him half!
say:21:1720815022:1.female: See? Mei, I promised her half!

say:22:1720815023:1.text: Even if my half doesn't count, you should at least exchange his share, right?
say:22:1720815023:1.source_cn: 我的那半不作数就算了，总还是要给<male>他</ma...
say:22:1720815023:1.male: Even if my half doesn't count, you should at least exchange his share, right?
say:22:1720815023:1.female: Even if my half doesn't count, you should at least exchange her share, right?

say:23:1720815024:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我只能按照会馆的规矩做事。

say:24:1720815025:1.text: If you wish to dispute them, you'll have to speak to the one who wrote them.
say:24:1720815025:1.source_cn: 要抗议的话，两位还是直接去找制定这些规矩的人吧。

choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 所以这些青符都不做数了？

choice:20:1:2.text: Half of zero... is still zero!
choice:20:1:2.male: Half of zero... is still zero!
choice:20:1:2.female: Half of zero... is still zero!

say:26:1720815010:1.text: ... I appreciate the effort, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but I'm not sure that helps.
say:26:1720815010:1.male: ... I appreciate the effort, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but I'm not sure that helps.
say:26:1720815010:1.female: ... I appreciate the effort, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but I'm not sure that helps.

say:27:1720815011:1.text: You see, it's a special feature of the pavilion's illusion magic.
say:27:1720815011:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，其实会馆的幻术魔法，还有一处特别的设计……
say:27:1720815011:1.male: You see, it's a special feature of the pavilion's illusion magic.
say:27:1720815011:1.female: You see, it's a special feature of the pavilion's illusion magic.

choice:7:1:2.text: What Valen? That's just a glimmerbloom.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 什么维伦？他只是一株荧荧花！
choice:7:1:2.male: What Valen? That's just a glimmerbloom.
choice:7:1:2.female: What Valen? That's just a glimmerbloom.

say:28:1720815012:1.text: Hehe... The pavilion's illusion magic has a special feature.
say:28:1720815012:1.source_cn: 呵呵……梅林阁下，您有所不知。事实上，会馆的幻术魔法，...
say:28:1720815012:1.male: Hehe... The pavilion's illusion magic has a special feature.
say:28:1720815012:1.female: Hehe... The pavilion's illusion magic has a special feature.

choice:7:2:3.text: What? Did the illusion magic fail?!
choice:7:2:3.source_cn: 霁月会馆的幻术魔法有破绽！
choice:7:2:3.male: What? Did the illusion magic fail?!
choice:7:2:3.female: What? Did the illusion magic fail?!
